init.load: model weights only, strict; a new optimizer, scaler, scheduler and RNG state; nothing is restored from latest.pt

model.name: ast_partial
model.frozen: blocks 0 to 9 and the embeddings, parameters and buffers

selection.metric: recording macro F1 at fixed threshold 0.5
selection.calibration_and_operating_roles: scored only after the selection is frozen; never used to choose an epoch or an experiment

decisions.authority: Plan R3-U2 prescribes: start from the warm-up checkpoint; unfreeze the last 2 blocks, the final norm and the head; rebuilt optimiser groups with backbone 1e-5, head 1e-4 and weight decay 0.01; effective batch 16 by accumulation; at most 6 to 10 epochs; warm-up then cosine decay; non-zero-gradient and changed/unchanged checksum evidence; one alternative if the budget allows; resume. Everything else below was an implementer's choice recorded for team review. The user reported on 12 November 2026 that the team agreed on this recipe; no individual approval record exists in the repository.
decisions.epochs: PLAN: 6 to 10. CHOICE: 8, the R1-U2 plan value (reports/r1/ast_probe.json plan.ast_partial_epochs). Always run all 8 and keep the best epoch (patience equals max epochs, so early stopping cannot fire and cut the cosine schedule short).
decisions.batch: PLAN: effective batch 16. CHOICE: microbatch 8 and accumulation 2, the R1-U2 recommended partial-stage setting; eval microbatch 16.
decisions.schedule: PLAN: warm-up then cosine. CHOICE: 114 linear warm-up optimiser steps (about 5 percent of the 2,272 steps: 284 per epoch times 8) then cosine to zero. The shared Trainer advances the scheduler once per optimiser attempt, including fp16 GradScaler-skipped steps (the same convention as the accepted R2-U2 run); skipped steps are counted and reported in the evidence.
decisions.precision: CHOICE: fp16 autocast with GradScaler, the R1-U2 and R2-U2 setting (T4 has no fast bf16). Scoring uses the same autocast, so a reloaded checkpoint reproduces its saved predictions.
decisions.alternative: PLAN: one alternative only if the budget allows. CHOICE: lower_backbone_lr, backbone 3e-6 with the head unchanged. A conservative variant for a 90-million-parameter backbone adapted on 4,530 recordings. Measured throughput (R1-U2: 36 clips/s partial training, 49 clips/s evaluation) puts one run at about 45 minutes, so both fit one Colab session.
decisions.class_strategy: CHOICE: natural composition (1,510 genuine and 3,020 TTS recordings), no rebalancing, as in R2-U2.
decisions.scope: One seeded 4-second crop per training recording per epoch. Selection validation only is read during training; calibration and operating audio is first scored by the export after the selection is frozen. No test and no Chatterbox audio.
decisions.selection: CONTRACT: epochs and experiments are chosen on selection-role recording macro F1 at fixed 0.5. Ties: earliest epoch, then baseline.
decisions.epoch0: Before training, the loaded warm-up is evaluated on the selection role (epoch 0). Its macro F1 must reproduce the R2-U2 value within warmup_epoch0_tolerance, which proves the right weights were loaded under the right preprocessing. Its predictions are the paired comparison for the adapted model.
decisions.seed: CHOICE: 42. Single seed: the difference between the two experiments, and between warm-up and adapted, may be within seed noise and the report must say so.
decisions.unseen_generator: Selection macro F1 is computed over all selection recordings (known generators and XTTS). Report the unseen-XTTS panel beside it; the frozen warm-up misses about half of XTTS at 0.5.
